description: This source file defines the LangFuseLogger class and associated helper functions for integrating Langfuse with a larger application, primarily for logging and tracing of model responses, events, and metadata. It handles initializing the Langfuse client, logging events asynchronously, capturing input/output contents, masking sensitive data, and supports multiple versions of the Langfuse SDK with version-specific features.
